narr: A potent spring storm system swept across the southeast during the day. An associated strong cold front moved with numerous strong to severe thunderstorms developing across the area, resulting in widespread wind damage and very heavy rain.
ev: Heavy rain caused water over several intersections along Old Shell Road.
lsr: SEVERAL INTERSECTIONS UNDER WATER ALONG OLD SHELL RD (NAMELY, THE INTERSECTIONS AT HALLET ST AND PINE ST.). REPORTS VIA SOCIAL MEDIA.
COCHRANE CAUSEWAY FLOODED IN BOTH DIRECTIONS.
